scope.description: Public VerifyLeader completion after observed higher-term voter-majority progress; endpoint is API success/error, not global consensus safety.
assumptions: Crash-free processes and functioning in-memory stores/FSMs
Delivery-only transport partition; optional pipelining unsupported
No further configuration or restore operation after prefix
excluded: Application read linearizability or conflicting committed logs
Generic pipeline correctness and stable storage crash faults

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Transport wrapper disables optional pipeline support and drops cross-partition AppendEntries; embedded InmemTransport disconnects all cross-partition routes.
Read-only observations count failed worker calls, inspect the applied log entry and FSM command counts. No target source or critical protocol state is changed.
Harness timeouts bound construction and completion; missing required events cannot be a passing comparison.
boundaries: Application read linearizability or conflicting committed logs
Generic pipeline correctness and stable storage crash faults
The measured endpoint is VerifyLeader error status; FSM counts are supplementary raw observations and not the oracle.
No claim of global correctness from a passing scenario; no claim of a consensus-safety violation from a failing API comparison.
Does not establish every deployment schedule, consensus log divergence, or a stale application read.
Specific cause beyond the mapped nonvoter callback route is not isolated by a separate counterfactual run.
Finite prefix or future timeout is incomplete observation, not a liveness failure.
No network backend or persistence backend claim.
